item.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.

item.title: Sam Altman isn’t the only one who wants to pump the brakes on AI
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo
item.description: After years of pushing full speed ahead on AI, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says maybe it’s time for the AI industry to “pace” itself. The comments came just days after one of OpenAI’s own models broke out of its test environment and got tangled up in a breach at Hugging Face — though as Equity’s hosts point out, sloppy security seems to have […]

item.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Snapchat has adjusted its recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.

item.title: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Apple CEO Tim Cook envisions users being able to buy more compute for Siri AI via Apple's existing iCloud+ subscriptions.

item.title: SpaceX won’t remove all of xAI’s unpermitted turbines for another year
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: SpaceX is building a new power plant for xAI's Colossus data centers, but it won't remove existing, unpermitted turbines for many more months.

item.title: Smallest.ai raises $13M to build ultra-fast voice AI that sounds genuinely human
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The startup is building voice models designed to make AI phone calls pass the Turing test.

item.title: AI labs want to pump the brakes, but Amazon and SpaceX are still blasting off
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane, Anthony Ha, Theresa Loconsolo
item.description: After years of pushing full speed ahead on AI, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says maybe it’s time for the AI industry to “pace” itself. The comments came just days after one of OpenAI’s own models broke out of its test environment and got tangled up in a breach at Hugging Face — though as Equity’s hosts point out, sloppy security seems to have […]

item.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents.

item.title: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness may have sold its public portfolio, but it still has its Anthropic shares
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The former OpenAI researcher’s fund was forced to unwind public equities after leveraged public bets plummeted. But he still has cards to play.

item.title: Reddit reports a solid quarter but shows signs of AI’s impact
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Reddit's financial situation is looking good but uncertainty about its relationship to Google and the new AI-ified web are stirring market concerns.

item.title: Investors love AI, as long as you’re a cloud host
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Amazon isn't slowing down on data center spending — but investors don't seem to mind.

item.title: Judge says Trump admin still lacks evidence for Anthropic ‘supply-chain risk’ label
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: A federal judge said the Trump administration has not presented enough evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply-chain risk, casting doubt on the government's ban on its AI technology.

item.title: Friend, the lonely AI wearable, returns with a new voice and a much bigger price tag
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Friend, the AI wearable, can now talk to its users — for an enhanced price.

item.title: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: As experts have warned for the last two years, some companies — like Microsoft and now Google — are finding and patching an exponential number of bugs in their products, thanks to the use of LLMs and AI tools.

item.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.

item.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso — source says for about $200M
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.

item.title: Meta says AI is making it easier to build new apps — and more are coming
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta says AI is making it dramatically easier to build and launch new consumer apps, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg telling investors the company has more new consumer products on the way.

item.title: Nscale buys Anyscale as it seeks to own more of the AI compute stack
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: British AI neocloud Nscale is buying software startup Anyscale, which helps companies scale their AI workloads across data centers and servers.

item.title: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: A new study estimates only 2,000 U.S. engineers have the expertise to deliver meaningful AI ROI, as enterprises race to hire forward-deployed engineers to implement AI at scale.

item.title: In the Hugging Face breach, OpenAI’s hacker was noisy and fast — but not unstoppable
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: Cybersecurity experts told TechCrunch that one of the biggest lessons to be taken from the OpenAI hack against Hugging Face has nothing to do with AI, but traditional cybersecurity defense.
